lcp-slow.title: Slow main content load
lcp-slow.detail: Main content appears in {lcp} ms. Aim for under 2500 ms: compress images, drop heavy scripts.

ttfb-slow.title: Slow server response
ttfb-slow.detail: The server responds in {ttfb} ms. Speed up the backend or add caching/CDN.

page-heavy.title: Heavy page
page-heavy.detail: The page weighs {mb} MB. Optimise images and scripts — aim for under 1.5 MB.

too-many-requests.title: Too many requests
too-many-requests.detail: The page makes {count} requests. Bundle files and remove the unused ones.

no-viewport.title: No mobile viewport
no-viewport.detail: Without a viewport tag the site doesn't adapt to phones. Add a meta viewport with width=device-width.

horizontal-overflow.title: Horizontal scrolling on mobile
horizontal-overflow.detail: Content is wider than the screen, causing horizontal scroll. Check fixed widths.

tap-targets-small.title: Tiny tap targets
tap-targets-small.detail: {count} buttons/links are smaller than 40×40 px — hard to hit with a finger.

font-too-small.title: Font too small
font-too-small.detail: Base font is {px} px. 16 px and up is comfortable on phones.

no-https.title: Site without HTTPS
no-https.detail: The connection isn't secure. Add an SSL certificate — it affects trust and SEO.

no-http-redirect.title: HTTP doesn't redirect to HTTPS
no-http-redirect.detail: The http:// version doesn't redirect to https://. Set up a permanent redirect.

missing-security-headers.title: Missing security headers
missing-security-headers.detail: {count} important security headers are missing (HSTS, CSP, etc.).

mixed-content.title: Mixed content
mixed-content.detail: An https page loads http resources — the browser flags the site as insecure.

cert-expiring.title: SSL certificate expiring soon
cert-expiring.detail: The certificate is valid for {days} more days. Renew it so the site keeps opening.

bad-title.title: Title tag issue
bad-title.detail: The page title is {length} characters. 30–60 is ideal — with a clear message.

bad-meta-description.title: Meta description issue
bad-meta-description.detail: The meta description is {length} characters. 50–160 is ideal — it's the search-result text.

h1-count.title: Wrong number of H1s
h1-count.detail: The page has {count} H1 headings. There should be exactly one.

images-without-alt.title: Images without alt
images-without-alt.detail: {count} images have no alt text — bad for SEO and accessibility.

no-open-graph.title: No Open Graph
no-open-graph.detail: Without og:title and og:image, the link looks dull when shared on social media.

no-lang.title: Page language not set
no-lang.detail: The <html> tag has no lang attribute — important for accessibility and search.

no-robots.title: No robots.txt
no-robots.detail: No robots.txt found — search engines struggle to understand the site's structure.

no-structured-data.title: No structured data
no-structured-data.detail: No JSON-LD markup — you're missing rich snippets in search.
